killedBy: formatDiagnostics files an unrequested default under its OWN heading, not under "requested"
formatDiagnostics keeps the two apart when both are present at once
why: Collapses the two sections back into one, so every note lands under "Requested, but not in effect". That is false on EVERY report this pane can produce: `sandboxDisarmed` defaults ON, so `explainDevConfig` emits an `inverted-default` note with no `requested` value on every developer session, and the heading would claim a request that was never made. Issue #247's criterion is that requested and effective "cannot be confused in the output", and one section for both directions is exactly that confusion. Found by the test rather than by inspection -- the first draft of this formatter had the single section.
